title: 899. Smallest Range II

examples.explanation: A single element always has spread 0.
Adjust to 2 and 8 (or -2 and 12); the best spread is 6.
Adjust to 4, 6 and 3 (each shifted by exactly 3); the spread is 6 - 3 = 3, which is optimal.

hints: Sort the array first: in an optimal answer the values raised by k form a prefix and the lowered ones a suffix (or vice versa).
